channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Gaza teams recover remains of 55 people nearly 3 years after Israeli strike
item.description: The victims, all from one Palestinian family, had been sheltering at their family home when Israel hit it.

item.title: Israel claims control of Lebanon’s key Ali al-Taher ridge: What that means
item.description: Israeli Defence Ministry asserts operational control over strategic highland; Hezbollah yet to comment.

item.title: US says it hit three Iranian oil tankers after attacks on warships
item.description: US Central Command says its forces struck three Iranian crude oil carriers on Saturday.

item.title: US says it hit Iran oil tankers helping finance ‘regional proxies’
item.description: US strikes have hit Iranian oil tankers in the Gulf of Oman and near Iran’s Kharg island.

item.title: Relatives hold cremations without bodies for Nepal’s missing flood victims
item.description: Fewer than one in 10 recovered bodies of people killed in deadly floods has been formally identified.

item.title: Iran President Pezeshkian calls for unity as US ramps up economic pressure
item.description: Amid rising public discontent, Iranian authorities say adversaries are focused on encouraging domestic unrest.

item.title: At least four civilians killed in Houthi missile strike near Yemen’s Taiz
item.description: The attack on a crowded road comes amid fierce clashes across Taiz and Hodeidah and rapid civilian displacement.

item.title: Yemen government launches own air attacks on Houthis: What that means
item.description: A major Houthi offensive towards Bab al-Mandeb has triggered some of Yemen’s worst fighting in years.

item.title: Mudslide in eastern China kills one, leaves 11 missing
item.description: A mudslide triggered by days of heavy rain in Jiangxi province, China, has killed one person and left 11 missing.

item.title: At least 5 killed in Russian attacks on Ukraine as US envoys visit Moscow
item.description: Ukraine and Russia announce a three-day limited ceasefire as Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner visit Moscow and Kyiv.
